reasoning_content: Now I'll create the GitHub workflow for Android CI/CD.

action.file_text:
name: Android Build

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'client/**'
      - '.github/workflows/android.yml'
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'client/**'
  workflow_dispatch:

env:
  JAVA_VERSION: '17'
  ANDROID_COMPILE_SDK: '34'
  ANDROID_BUILD_TOOLS: '34.0.0'
  ANDROID_TARGET_SDK: '34'
  ANDROID_MIN_SDK: '24'

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Java
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          java-version: ${{ env.JAVA_VERSION }}
          distribution: 'temurin'
          cache: 'gradle'

      - name: Setup Android SDK
        uses: android-actions/setup-android@v2

      - name: Cache Gradle
        uses: actions/cache@v3
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.gradle/caches
            ~/.gradle/wrapper
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-gradle-${{ hashFiles('**/gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.jar') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-gradle-

      - name: Grant execute permission for gradlew
        working-directory: client/android
        run: chmod +x gradlew

      - name: Build with Gradle
        working-directory: client/android
        run: ./gradlew assembleRelease

      - name: Upload APK
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: arelorian-release.apk
          path: client/android/app/build/outputs/apk/release/*.apk

      - name: Upload Debug Symbols
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: debug-symbols
          path: client/android/app/build/outputs/mapping

      - name: Upload Build Logs
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: build-logs
          path: |
            client/android/app/build/outputs/**/logs/
            client/android/build/**/*.log
